{"data":{"id":"1357004","key":"ENG-5649","fields":{"summary":"Audit - Izenda reports will not export/download and dates are disappearing since Platform","description":"

The Izenda reports will not export properly when trying to export to Excel. One report we tested with multiple users is Store Audits by Status with date range. When we click export to excel it either does nothing OR will download one time (and one time only). The date ranges are also refreshing and clearing out each time we click update (which it did not do that in the past).

Claude Analysis:

Summary: Guess (GES #41) — Izenda completely non-functional for export and query compilation post-Platform Cohesion migration. Display renders correct 2026 data through the Yarp proxy path; all designer-initiated backend operations (Excel export, SQL view) are dead. When export occasionally succeeds (per client), it returns 2025 data from the old dbo database.

Triage Breakdown

  • Layer 1 — Product: Guess on Platform Cohesion (netTrack), apps.apprissretail.com/guess/nettrack/. Migration status: ✓ Complete per Incident Migration 2026.xlsx. Prod Sync = N (old dbo database is NOT syncing from incident schema). Client #41, Server 7, CSM: Valerie Cerezo.

  • Layer 2 — Frontend or Backend: Backend. The report displays correct 2026 data on screen. Every designer-initiated backend operation fails — Excel export produces no request to rs.aspx, and the SQL view button also fails to compile or return the query. The entire backend query compilation and export pipeline is broken for this tenant. Only the display rendering path (which routes through Yarp correctly) is functional.

  • Layer 3 — Schema or Flow: Flow — the designer and export code paths cannot reach the backend in PC mode. The pCohesion cookie (50040-41) is present on the display path and IsPlatformCohesionMode() returns true for rendering, but designer-initiated operations (export, SQL view) either can't resolve the PC-mode connection or aren't receiving the pCohesion context at all. When the export does occasionally succeed (per client), it falls through to the dbo connection string and returns pre-migration 2025 data.

Replication — July 2, 2026 (Tyrone Whitney)

Logged into Guess production at apps.apprissretail.com/guess/nettrack/. Navigated to Monthly Reporting → External Theft Details.

Display path: Working. Report renders 2026 data correctly. All rs.aspx calls return 200.

Export attempt — F12 Network trace:

  • Baseline: 104 requests, all healthy

  • Clicked export: request count went to 105

  • New request was a POST to ReportDesigner.aspx (page postback) — NOT an rs.aspx?output=XLS(MIME) export call

  • No export request ever reached the ResponseServer

  • No file downloaded, no error, no visible feedback

 

SQL view attempt:

  • Clicked the SQL button in the designer toolbar

  • Also failed — could not compile or display the underlying query

  • Confirms the failure is not limited to file export — the entire backend query compilation pipeline is broken for designer-initiated operations

Report Designer — Filters tab inspection:

  • Filter 1: CaseType = Equals (Multiple) — "Defeated Sensors" selected

  • Filter 2: IncidentDate = Between(Calendar) — 1/1/2025 to 9/30/2025 (saved defaults)

  • Filter 3: Inactive = Equals 0

  • The saved report definition contains 2025 date parameters. Stephanie overrides these to 2026 at runtime in the viewer and the display updates correctly — but the export, when it works, compiles against the saved 2025 defaults rather than the runtime overrides. This explains why the client's exported file contains 2025 data with month range 1–9 that exactly matches the saved filter range.

Cookie/configuration state confirmed via F12 Headers:

  • pCohesion=50040-41 — PC mode active on display path

  • izscResponseServer=/guess/nettrack/AdHoc/rs.aspx — V1 fix (PR 51462) deployed

  • ntSECURITY present with full role payload

  • ntWEBCFG shows PLT=1&PLTFRMID=41

Console: CSS vendor prefix warnings only. No JavaScript errors related to export or SQL compilation.

Client-provided export file (External_Theft_Details__34_.xls):

  • HTML-MIME format (Izenda XLS wrapper)

  • 100% of records: Year(IncidentDate) = 2025, months 1–9

  • Zero 2026 records

  • Data spans all store types — database-level, not filter-specific

  • Date range in export matches the saved report filters (1/1/2025–9/30/2025), not the client's runtime 2026 overrides

Root Cause Analysis

Two failures stacked on top of each other, both originating from the PC-mode export pipeline:

Failure 1 — Backend operations dead in designer. Export, SQL view, and any designer-initiated backend call cannot resolve the PC-mode connection. The display path works because it routes through Yarp correctly and receives pCohesion context. The designer/export path does not. This is the same class of issue as RCS-26500.

Failure 2 — When export does succeed, it returns wrong data. The export falls through to the dbo connection string (pre-migration, frozen at 2025) and compiles against saved report filter defaults (1/1/2025–9/30/2025) rather than the user's runtime overrides. Both the connection and the filter state are wrong on the export path.

Save As will not resolve either failure. The connection routing and filter state serialization are runtime pipeline issues, not report definition issues.

Three Symptoms — Unified Root Cause

#

Symptom

Finding

Severity

A

Export does nothing when clicked

F12: export fires POST to ReportDesigner.aspx, never generates rs.aspx?output=XLS. SQL view also fails. Entire designer backend pipeline is dead.

Critical

B

Date range filters clearing on Update

Likely same pipeline — filter state not persisting through the PC-mode session. Not yet isolated separately.

Medium

C

Export pulls 2025 data when it works

Export falls to dbo connection, compiles against saved 2025 filter defaults instead of runtime overrides. Client file confirms 100% 2025 data matching saved filter range.

Critical

All three symptoms trace back to the designer/export code path not operating correctly in PC mode for this tenant.

Escalation Path

  • Owner: Kiran Vadday (Platform Cohesion / ENG-3031)

  • Related: RCS-26500 (Tailored Brands — same pattern), ENG-3031 (PRs 51462 and 53581)

  • Questions for Engineering:

    1. Is the V3 fix (PR 53581) deployed to Guess production? V1 ResponseServer path is confirmed active, but designer backend operations (export, SQL view) are completely non-functional.

    2. Why are designer-initiated backend operations failing to reach rs.aspx while the display rendering path works? Is IsPlatformCohesionMode() returning false in the designer context?

    3. When export occasionally succeeds (per client), the connection falls through to dbo and filter state serializes saved defaults instead of runtime values — is the session/cookie context being lost between the viewer and the export callback?

Scope — Not Guess-Specific

This likely affects all ✓ Complete PC-mode tenants with Prod Sync = N: Guess, Tailored Brands, Casey's, Chemist Warehouse, WSS, PVH, Alo Yoga, Secure Integration. Recommend Engineering validate export AND SQL compilation across all completed tenants.
